purpose: Phase 3 — In-Range Refresh & Declaration Alignment. Documents (a) every declaration-drift family that was reconciled in W3 to a single floor, and (b) every drift entry that was intentionally retained (with a justification). The w3 Red-phase TDD suite asserts this fixture exists, has the documented schema, and that no drift row claims a family outside the W3 reconciliation scope. Green behavior: a w3 Green commit writes the reconciled manifest floors and intentional retentions here so future waves can re-verify AC6 (version declaration drift is either reconciled or documented as intentional).

reconciled.reconciliation_strategy: Tighten the floor in packages/activity-components and packages/lesson-renderer from ^0.16.21 to ^0.16.45 to match apps/integrated-math-3. Activity-components and lesson-renderer are W5-remaining candidates for the 0.16→0.17 major migration, so the P3 floor must still admit that target (^0.16.45 admits 0.17 only as a breaking change; W5 handles it).

Tighten packages/lesson-renderer (^0.475.0) and packages/app-shell (^0.468.0) to ^0.511.0 to match the five first-class apps. lucide-react is a W5-remaining candidate (0.x→1.x), so the W3 floor does not need to admit 1.x; W5 is the major migration.
Tighten packages/lesson-renderer from ^3.0.2 to ^3.3.0 to match the five first-class apps. tailwind-merge is a stable 3.x line; the lesson-renderer floor was lagging by three minor versions.
Tighten packages/srs-engine from ^5.0.0 to ^5.3.2 to match the apps. The srs-engine floor was lagging because srs-engine tracks the FSRS algorithm stable major; the apps were ahead on a patch.

Tighten the 19 first-class apps + shared packages (currently ^4.0.16) to ^4.1.8 to match packages/practice-test-engine post-W2. The vitest 2.x→4.x drift was resolved by W2 (security wave); W3 closes the residual 4.0.16 vs 4.1.8 floor drift.

Convert the four hard-pinned `15.3.1` declarations in apps/integrated-math-{1,2,3} and apps/pre-calculus to a `^15.3.1` range that matches apps/bus-math-v2. test-strategy.md §3 explicitly requires that the P3 alignment does NOT pin eslint-config-next@15 in a way that blocks W4; a `^` range admits 16.x.
Tighten the five first-class apps (^20) to ^22 to match packages/lesson-renderer. TypeScript 5→6 (W4) and Node 22 LTS are the post-W3 baseline; keeping apps on ^20 would force a W4 double-bump.

Tighten the four first-class apps currently on `^9` to `^9.39.4` to match apps/bus-math-v2. The `^9` floor was lagging by 39 minor versions; bumping to bm2's floor eliminates a long-running W4 blocker for the ESLint 9→10 migration.
